tasks.title: #241 H6099 video mode: DreamView switch from the aa 05 frame, ON via ptReal, OFF via colour restore
tasks.notes: Research §Q3. Two users' video-on diagnostics carry aa050000083200023200000000000000000000a5 (XOR ok) and state.mode 0; existing H66A0 code reads dreamview_enabled = raw[2]==0x00 (models/state.py:706-733). H6099 advertises no dreamViewToggle, so supports_dreamview (models/device.py:912-925) is False and no switch is created (switch.py:179; frame gate coordinator.py:4133). Add const FRAME_DREAMVIEW_SKUS = frozenset({"H6099"}) (comment cites #241) and make supports_dreamview return True for it (mirror the MOVIE_MODE_DREAMVIEW_SKUS branch); add H6099 to DREAMVIEW_STATE_FROM_FRAMES_SKUS (const.py:285) and PTREAL_DREAMVIEW_SKUS (const.py:601). ON frame (33 05 00 01 00 64) unverified on H6099: user chose control anyway; frame-reported state makes a no-op visible. Tests: H6099 golden frame -> True, a valid aa05 15.. colour frame -> False, bad XOR ignored, H6099 device without the cap -> supports_dreamview True and a DreamView switch is created (test_cov_switch.py), ON sends build_dreamview_packet over ptReal, OFF restores colour. Depends on T-002 only because both edit const.py. Commit subject cites #241.

tasks.title: DIY scenes: record each device's DIY fetch result in diagnostics; log when a DIY-capable device returns none
tasks.notes: Research §Q4 (#314, #296, #298, #281). Today diagnostics only show diy_scene_cache_count (diagnostics.py:373), so an upstream empty list and a setup-time fetch error (scene_cache.py:284-293 returns [] uncached) look the same. Keep the last DIY fetch outcome per device in the scene cache (count, or the error class name; never the scene names, which are user-chosen) and emit it per device in diagnostics under key "diy_scenes" ({"count": n} or {"error": "<ExceptionClass>"}). In select.py:175-186, when a device supports diyScene but the list is empty, log one debug line containing the words 'no DIY scenes'. No behaviour change: entity creation, caching and refresh stay as they are. Privacy: no device names or scene names in diagnostics beyond what is already there.
